title: FCA-lab-OEO
description: Software for OEO necessary-attribute rule extraction, classification, and experimental reproduction, including the three-way object-oriented concept-construction workflow associated with Zhang et al. (2025), A Fast Algorithm for Three-Way Object-Oriented Concept Acquisition (doi:10.3390/app15126486). Includes algorithms, tests, dependency specifications, data preparation and reproduction instructions. External datasets are obtained separately from their providers.
